affordance_in_statement: For the network to remain stable, the tiers assigned to any two servers connected by a synchronization link must have different parities.
removal_suggestion: No semantics-preserving wording change can remove this affordance: with exactly tiers 1 and 2 and a pairwise opposite-tier constraint, the task is intrinsically bipartite 2-coloring.

common_affordance: The equivalence between assigning tiers 1 and 2 with opposite parity on every link and finding a bipartite coloring of the graph.
recommended_edit: No edit can defeat all survivors without changing the core task; merely replacing the word "parities" with an equivalent compatibility rule preserves the same bipartite problem.
